findings.title: [P2] Preserve the empty-name return contract
findings.body: For `profile.name === ""` or a whitespace-only string, `trim()` returns `""`; changing `??` to `||` now replaces that value with `"Anonymous"`. This is an observable contract change even though the PR says existing contracts are preserved, so callers that distinguish a supplied blank name from a missing name receive a different result. Keep the nullish fallback or explicitly update the contract and its consumers/tests.
